Radio Pakistan & PTV Programs
Collaboration with Radio & PTV
PTA in collaboration with Radio & PTV, participated in following programs in which public especially parents and youngsters were guided about safe and responsible use of internet:
a)  Radio program “Rabta” (September 13, 2023)
b)  Radio Pakistan - Online Podcast (November 20, 2023)
https://podcast.radio.gov.pk/20-11-2023/director-web-analysis-pta-muhammad-farooq-world-childrens-day20231120234026?v=1&header=1
c)  PTV program - “Subhe Pakistan” (October 2, 2023)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2AiezbcjbCo
d)  PTV program - “Subhe Pakistan” (February 6, 2024)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w55C7j66068
e)  Radio Pakistan - Online Podcast (February 6, 2024)
https://www.facebook.com/share/v/d3ZeJGALGntig58F/?mibextid=WC7FNe
f)  PTV program - “Ura’an” (Oct 26, 2024)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H_oQ6gAiZAE

## Collaboration with Google
- **Source URL**: https://www.pta.gov.pk/category/collaboration-with-google-1654883937-2025-02-18

Collaboration with Google
Collaboration with Google
×
Print
Collaboration with Google
PTA is thrilled to announce an exciting collaboration with Google to enhance Child Online Protection. Key areas for collaboration are being identified to make a significant impact in this field. By joining Google’s Digital Literacy program for Schools of Pakistan, PTA is set to make a major leap forward in educating and safeguarding young internet users. This partnership represents a crucial step in creating a safer and more informed digital landscape for children across the nation.

## Consumer Protection
- **Source URL**: https://www.pta.gov.pk/category/consumer-protection-58770853-2023-05-30

Consumer Protection
Consumer Protection
×
Print
Consumer Protection
Functions:
This Division is responsible for addressing of telecom consumer complaints made to the Authority through various means like Complaint Management System, Toll Free Number, Telephone, Fax, E-mail, Web mail & through post. CP also carry out analysis of consumer complaints with a view to isolate key problem areas and their rectification from the telecom operators. They aim to gauge the pulse of telecom consumers with a view to pursue matters with the industry to achieve maximum consumer satisfaction. CP playing proactive role in taking up issues that are found to be violating consumer provisions given in the Telecom Act and PTA regulations and to take measures against practices that may harm consumer interests in accordance with law. CP also identify Regulatory mechanism for larger consumer protection in telecom sector.

## TikTok Youth Safety Summit 2024
- **Source URL**: https://www.pta.gov.pk/category/tiktok-youth-safety-summit-2024-575744770-2025-02-18

TikTok Youth Safety Summit 2024
TikTok Youth Safety Summit 2024
×
Print
TikTok Youth Safety Summit 2024
Event – TikTok Youth Safety Summit – 21st Nov 2024
PTA in collaboration with TikTok, organized the Youth Safety Summit in Islamabad on November 21, 2024. The event convened representatives from government, education, and child protection sectors to discuss strategies for safeguarding young internet users. An informative Panel Discussion was carried out during the Summit on “Enhancing Child Online Safety: Strategies for Preventions, Interventions and Collaboration”. Representatives from PTA, CERT, UNICEF Pakistan and SAHIL joined the panel as subject matter experts offering diverse perspectives on child protection. The event concluded with the #DigitalHifazat Contest winners’ (a video curating competition launched jointly by PTA & TikTok). Further details of the event can be checked at the mentioned link:  https://www.urdupoint.com/en/pakistan/tiktok-pta-host-youth-safety-summit-to-promo-1884602.html
Video Competition Details: The competition was aimed to promote digital safety awareness among Pakistani youth. The contest invited creators to produce short videos highlighting six key areas: responsible social media usage, combating online harassment, preventing online fraud, ensuring youth safety and well-being, understanding TikTok's safety tools and addressing misinformation.
The competition received 11,000 entries and top 3 winners received the winning prizes, recognized for exceptional creativity in promoting digital safety among Pakistani youth. Top 5 videos are being uploaded through PTA’s Official Social Media accounts for wider dissemination.

Chairman's Message
At the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA), we are committed to building a digitally inclusive, secure, and forward-looking Pakistan. Our mission is to ensure that every citizen regardless of geography or background, has access to reliable, affordable, and high-quality telecommunications and digital services.
In today’s fast evolving world, digital connectivity is no longer a luxury, it is a fundamental enabler for education, healthcare, business, and social inclusion. On this transformative journey, PTA stands as both a catalyst and a guardian of progress, shaping regulatory and licensing landscape guided by technological advancement that not only support innovation but also protect the rights and interests of users.
In line with this commitment, we take pride in remarkable strides made by Pakistan’s telecom sector including record growth in telecom subscribers, substantial expansion of  broadband coverage and the local manufacturing of millions of mobile devices. PTA has also laid the foundation for adoption of future technologies such as 5G, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and advanced Wi-Fi standards, ensuring that Pakistan remains at the forefront of digital transformation. These achievements are not merely milestones for the industry but represent steps toward creating a technologically advanced Pakistan and strengthening the national economy.
Yet, our work is far from done. We are steadfast in our resolve to bridge the digital divide, enhance cybersecurity, encourage public private collaboration, and ensure that Pakistan is ready to embrace the future technological advancements. As we move forward, transparency, consumer protection, and equitable growth will remain at the heart of all our initiatives.
On behalf of PTA, I extend my sincere gratitude to the telecom industry, partners, and the people of Pakistan for their trust and support. Together, we will continue to shape a resilient digital future, one that ensures connectivity, opportunity, safety, and prosperity for the people of Pakistan.
